_about: THE one price list. Every game's pricing.ts, common.js and price pages are checked against it (parity.test.ts) and rewritten from it (sync.mjs). 'live' is what the games charge today; 'target' is the new ladder of the master console (taken from data/console-mockup-v2/index.html line 500). 'applied' says per game which of the two the game must show right now; a game is switched to the target only after the owner says go (prices of live games change).

target._usd_note: Decision D3 is open. Dollar prices of the new ladder are NOT invented here. Until the owner fills them in, a game keeps its current dollar prices for the sizes it has today and the 50-person size is not sold in dollars.
